{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kalai language''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Kalai]] [[Species/Legends|species]], mysterious beings who inhabited [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|''Zirtran's Anchor'']], in the [[Phosphura Belt Nebula/Legends|Phosphura Belt Nebula]]. The language was difficult to translate into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].

Their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and residence was named in this language, but other inhabitants of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] referred to it by the closest approximation in Basic, [[Destiny (Zirtran's Anchor)|''Destiny'']].
